title: Campaign: ReadyNeuro, patterns along place within one brain
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what new facts about human brain activity can ReadyNeuro reveal?'. Scope: Relations between brain locations in the same person and run. How it splits: Do the related places change at the same moment (zero lag at 1 s sampling) or with a measurable delay? It holds 5 leaf studies with first tests (universal-components, wm-bold, fast-lag, csf-coupling, subcortical-lead). No results yet.
